definitions.open_postings: Open remote job postings in RemoteHunt's public index on the counting day: live, remote, and listed on the site's public job pages.
definitions.open (country): Postings that can hire in the country: they say they hire worldwide, or their list of countries or regions includes it.
definitions.named (country): Postings whose list names the country itself, counted inside open.
definitions.single_country: Postings whose list holds exactly one country.
definitions.multi_country: Postings that list two or more countries, or a region.
definitions.hire_worldwide: Postings that say they hire anywhere.
definitions.hiring_location_not_stated: Postings that state no readable hiring location.
definitions.us_only: Postings whose list holds the United States and nothing else.
definitions.europe_only: Postings whose list holds only European countries.
definitions.with_stated_pay: Postings that state a salary or a salary range.
definitions.pay: Annual US dollars, the midpoint of the stated range. Pay by role and by role x seniority covers postings published in the last 90 days that state a full range; a figure needs at least 20 such postings, else it is left empty.
definitions.profession: The posting's profession as RemoteHunt files it; professions with fewer than 20 open postings are left out of the table, not counted as 0.
definitions.family: A group of professions (Engineering, Sales, ...) as on the site's country pages.
definitions.seniority: Junior (intern, junior, entry), Mid-level, Senior, Staff & Principal (lead, staff, principal), Management (manager, director, VP, C-level), Other, Not stated.
definitions.change: Value minus the value in the previous edition (normally one week earlier); empty when either value is not measured.
definitions.country_league: Every country with a RemoteHunt country page, plus the United States, ranked by open; country_page is its page on the site, empty when it has none. only_country: postings whose list holds that country and nothing else; with_others_or_region: postings that list it beside other countries or through a region; anywhere: postings that hire from any country. The three add up to open. share_pct is open out of open_postings in summary.csv.
definitions.only_country_median_pay_usd: Median of the annual US-dollar midpoints of the only_country postings that state pay; empty under 20 such postings.
